configuration_rationale: One preregistered physical measurement integrity pilot on verified SF1; four existing query templates run as controls, simultaneous diagnostic clients with one real binpack rewrite, then post-rewrite. This offered-load pattern tests instrumentation, not a traced workload. Default Iceberg binpack eligibility; atomic commit only. Require at least one verified overlap to demonstrate the physical path; non-overlapping queries must not be treatment labels. No model/benefit claim. Preserve the measured source file count by explicit repartitioning in the diagnostic clone; ordinary CTAS may coalesce scan tasks and fail to provide meaningful multi-file rewrite eligibility. This layout intervention is recorded and does not represent naturally observed fragmentation. Registered second pilot after explicit post-commit session-refresh repair; acceptance gates unchanged from first pilot, retained separately as failed evidence.

telemetry.rationale: One-second host counter sampling independent of queries, 60-second historical window, five-second warmup margin; tolerate at most two-second gap/freshness and require 95% measured coverage. These are explicit observer-integrity tolerances, not policy/model accuracy thresholds. 300-second windows remain separately unvalidated.
